augmentation.suppress_when: same class and squared XY distance strictly less than 4 to any retained detection

comparator.adjudication: Independent arrangement, conflict rules and consequential-error rubric required before freeze; no self-adjudicated superiority.
comparator.author: competent independent analyst; not yet secured

limits: Historical detector outputs do not benchmark current frontier models.
Detection-count loss excludes latency, planner response and crash loss.
A reference-model enclosure is not a physical 95% interval.
One resolved addition comparison is not demonstrated software superiority.
This design does not establish a buyer, valuation or product-runtime authority.

matching.certificate: matching plus vertex cover of equal size for each configuration
matching.numerical_policy: exact source-decimal squared comparisons; physical/calibration/time uncertainty separate
matching.witness_tie_policy: deterministic stable-identity traversal; exact implementation bound before freeze

pointer_policy: Source paths are basenames for identification only; payloads are not distributed or resolved relative to this plan. Private custody retains exact source locations. Bind required real inputs before execution.

population.exclusion: Candidate closed +/-2-second window intersects a prior development case exposed-interval hull, including its declared context and exposed sensor timestamps, in the same scene.
population.sample: 60 eligible scenes uniform without replacement, then one eligible anchor uniform within each selected scene.
population.seed_rule: fresh seed after exact method/protocol/input/reviewer/comparator/seed procedure freeze
population.substitution_policy: none; retain every selected anchor and explicit unavailable state

primary.coarse_bound_per_anchor: [-b*r,a*r]; r = retained additions; [-r,r] for the primary loss
primary.uncertainty: verified outer enclosure of model-compatible contrasts

reference_cache_policy: Filtered historical gt_val_cache.json is not a complete physical reference. Bind full annotation tables and raw observation windows separately.

reference_review.cross_anchor_constraints: preserve or identify conservative per-anchor projection
reference_review.phase_1: Independent timestamped raw-camera/lidar discovery; no annotations, detector overlays, configuration identities or prior rankings. Lock both records.
reference_review.phase_2: Full annotations and anonymized predictions for proposal-assisted inspection; retain phase and original alternatives.
reference_review.unlisted_matchable_objects: retain possible effects with justified relaxation or unconditional fallback; no arbitrary closure
reference_review.world_model: Shared object presence/class/alias/geometry/time alternatives; preserve joint constraints and base-neighbor matching paths.

scope: One finite-cohort blinded reference study of a nested offline output addition; no deployment or causal-modality inference.

target.detection_range: nominal global XY relative to anchor ego XY
target.object_range: true center in each shared reference interpretation
target.reference_time: anchor timestamp; retrospective raw context, not runtime availability
